lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 유럽 배낭여행 정말 재미있었죠?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, the Europe backpacking trip was really fun, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, yureop baenangnyeohaeng jeongmal jaemiisseotjyo?
lines.learner: 네, 그런데 저는 실수를 많이 하고 말았어요.
lines.en: Yes, but I ended up making a lot of mistakes.
lines.roman: Ne, geureonde jeoneun silsureul mani hago marasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What mistakes? Is it about when we left the country?
lines.learner: 출국 날 공항에 늦게 가고 말았어요.
lines.en: On departure day, I ended up getting to the airport late.
lines.roman: Chulgung nal gonghang-e neutge gago marasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: That's right. Was the lodging okay?
lines.learner: 숙박비가 싼 곳에 묵었는데 방이 너무 작았어요.
lines.en: We stayed somewhere cheap, but the room was too small.
lines.roman: Sukbakbiga ssan gose mugeonneunde bang-i neomu jagasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: In Paris, you read the hotel name wrong, didn't you?
lines.learner: 네, 다른 호텔에 가고 말았어요. 정말 미안했어요.
lines.en: Yes, I ended up going to another hotel. I was really sorry.
lines.roman: Ne, dareun hotere gago marasseoyo. Jeongmal mianhaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Haha, but there were so many things to see, right?
lines.learner: 네, 구경거리가 정말 많았어요. 야경이 최고였어요.
lines.en: Yes, there was so much to see. The night view was the best.
lines.roman: Ne, gugyeonggeoriga jeongmal manasseoyo. Yagyeong-i choegoyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Right. The streets felt very exotic too.
lines.learner: 네, 그런데 기념품을 너무 많이 사고 말았어요.
lines.en: Yes, but I ended up buying too many souvenirs.
lines.roman: Ne, geureonde ginyeompumeul neomu mani sago marasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: The airfare was expensive too, so you must have spent a lot.
lines.learner: 맞아요. 다음 여름휴가에는 콘도에 묵을 거예요.
lines.en: Right. Next summer vacation, I'll stay at a condo.
lines.roman: Majayo. Daeum yeoreumhyugaeneun kondoe mugeul geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: A condo? Where do you want to go to beat the heat?
lines.learner: 해변이 있는 곳이요. 휴가철에는 사람이 많겠지만요.
lines.en: Somewhere with a beach. Though it'll be crowded in vacation season.
lines.roman: Haebyeoni inneun gosiyo. Hyugacheoreneun sarami manketjimanyo.

lines.beaver: 민수 씨는 또 가 보고 싶은 곳이 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, is there anywhere else you want to visit?
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssineun tto ga bogo sipeun gosi isseoyo?
lines.learner: 언젠가 아프리카에서 특별한 체험을 해 보고 싶어요.
lines.en: Someday I want to have a special experience in Africa.
lines.roman: Eonjenga apeurikaeseo teukbyeolhan cheheomeul hae bogo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver: 좋네요. 한국에 오는 친구에게는 어디를 추천해요?
lines.beaver_en: Nice. Where do you recommend to friends visiting Korea?
lines.beaver_roman: Jonneyo. Hanguge oneun chinguegeneun eodireul chucheonhaeyo?
lines.en: Gyeongbokgung Palace. This trip was really fun!
